title: showsite.json
description: Settings for a showsite video. Create one with: npx showsite init <url>

url.description: The page to record, e.g. "https://example.com" or "localhost:3000".

format.description: Video shape. 16:9 for YouTube and X, 1:1 for feeds, 9:16 for Reels, TikTok and Shorts.

frame.description: What the site sits in. Defaults to "phone" for 9:16 and "browser" otherwise. A phone shows the site's mobile layout.

background.description: ink, coral, mist, white, black, forest, ocean, or any CSS color or gradient.

theme.description: Record the site's light or dark mode (for sites that follow the system setting).

language.description: Browser language, e.g. "ar" to get the Arabic version of a site that picks it from the browser.

enabled.description: Show the text above the site.

animation.description: words: each word rises in. fade: the line fades in. none: no animation.

music.description: Music composed for this video, timed to its cuts: upbeat (120 bpm, drums come in at the first cut) or calm (90 bpm, soft). It's generated by showsite, so there's nothing to license. Ignored when "audio" is set.

sfx.description: A soft whoosh on each camera move.

audio.description: Your own music or voiceover (mp3, m4a, wav), used instead of the composed music. Relative paths are relative to this file.

fitToAudio.description: Stretch or shrink the scenes so the video is exactly as long as the audio.

hide.description: CSS selectors to hide while recording. Common cookie banners and chat widgets are hidden already.

maxScenes.description: Upper limit when showsite picks the sections itself (when "scenes" is empty).

scenes.description: Scenes in the order they play. Leave empty to let showsite pick.

section.description: A section number from "availableSections" (1, 2, 3...) or a CSS selector such as "#pricing".

caption.description: Text above the site for this scene. Use "" for no caption. Arabic and mixed text work.

duration.description: Seconds on screen, including the move into this section. Default 3 (3.4 for the first scene).

camera.description: scroll: drift down through the section. zoom: slow push-in. hold: stay still. Default: zoom for the first scene, scroll for the rest.

availableSections.description: Written by "showsite init" for reference. Ignored when recording.

addressBar.description: Text in the browser frame's address bar. Defaults to the site's host, e.g. to show your real domain while recording localhost.

chromePath.description: Use this Chrome or Chromium executable.
